nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Worker notifies employer of injury
nodes.rule_text: You must notify your employer within 30 days, but it is best to do so as soon as possible.

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Worker files Form C-3
nodes.rule_text: Form C-3 must be filed within two years of the accident
nodes.deadline_text: within two years of the accident

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Employer reports injury to insurer
nodes.rule_text: Report most injuries and occupational diseases to the employer's insurance carrier within 10 days after an accident

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Insurer gives worker a written statement of rights
nodes.rule_text: This must be provided within 14 days after the employers' notification of injury/illness
nodes.deadline_text: within 14 days after the employer's notification

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Insurer files notice of controversy to dispute a claim
nodes.rule_text: To contest a claim, an insurer must notify you and file a notice of controversy with the Board within 18 days
nodes.deadline_text: RD02 says 18 days; RD03 also says "a notice of controversy shall be filed with the Board within 25 days". The two time limits run from different start points; check the full text.

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Insurer starts lost-wage payments when lost time exceeds seven days
nodes.rule_text: The insurer begins the payment of benefits if lost time exceeds seven days.

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Weekly benefit set at two-thirds of average weekly wage
nodes.rule_text: To calculate your benefit, the Board uses two-thirds of your AWW and then adjusts it by your degree of disability.

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Treatment follows the Medical Treatment Guidelines
nodes.rule_text: Use of the guidelines is mandatory for treatment rendered for conditions for which there is a final effective MTG.

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Doctor requests a variance before care that differs from the guidelines
nodes.rule_text: A variance must be requested before medical care that varies from the MTGs is provided to the patient

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Worker requests reimbursement of medical travel and expenses
nodes.rule_text: Submit the completed form and copies of all receipts or bills to the workers' compensation insurance carrier

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Prior authorization for a drug outside the formulary
nodes.rule_text: A medical provider must obtain prior authorization before prescribing or dispensing a drug other than as described

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Law judge hears the case and decides
nodes.rule_text: The judge hears testimony, reviews medical records and wages, then decides on a resolution and the amount of any award.

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Attorney asks the Board for further action
nodes.rule_text: This form is for use by claimant's attorney or licensed representative ONLY.

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Section 32 settlement negotiated and sent to the Board
nodes.rule_text: A Section 32 Waiver Agreement is a negotiated settlement between you and the insurer.

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Medicare's interests considered in a settlement
nodes.rule_text: When settling a workers' compensation claim, the parties must take into account Medicare's interests.

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Worker may withdraw from a Section 32 agreement
nodes.rule_text: You have 10 calendar days from the date that the Section 32 Waiver Agreement was submitted to the Board

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Worker shares restrictions with employer to find duty within limits
nodes.rule_text: Communicate your medical restrictions to your employer for duty options within your limitations.

nodes.label: ProcessStep
nodes.name: Employer reports changes in pay or work status
nodes.rule_text: Report any changes in an injured worker’s pay or work status to the Board
